# Tasks — Modular ChatGPT Userscripts (Vite+ + TS)

 - [ ] Initialize repo scaffolding and configs
   - Role: build-tooling engineer
   - Task: Add `package.json` scripts (`bootstrap`, `dev`, `build`, `typecheck`, `lint`, `lint:fix`, `zip`), `tsconfig.json`, empty `entries.json`, and folder structure (`entries/`, `shared/`, `scripts/`). Prepare Vite+ config skeleton without implementation details.
   - Restrictions: Do not import external libs yet; no bundling of mermaid/jsdiff/highlight at this step.
   - _Leverage: requirements.md, design.md
   - _Requirements: Outputs, Scripts, Constraints
   - Success: Files exist; `npm run typecheck` and `npm run lint` run (even if no sources yet).

 - [ ] Implement Vite+ multi-entry build with userscript header plugin
   - Role: vite+ plugin engineer
   - Task: Implement `vite.config.ts` that reads `entries.json`, sets inputs, and injects userscript headers from per-entry metadata. Support `@require` externals.
   - Restrictions: Do not change userscript behavior; no runtime code yet.
   - _Leverage: design.md (Build System section)
   - _Requirements: Build, Outputs
   - Success: `npm run build` emits `dist/<entry>.user.js` for sample placeholder entry.

 - [ ] Add CLI scaffold script `scripts/scaffold.ts`
   - Role: DX tooling engineer
   - Task: Create a CLI that adds `entries/<name>/index.ts` and `metadata.ts`, and registers in `entries.json`.
   - Restrictions: Keep templates minimal; no dependencies beyond standard libs.
   - _Leverage: design.md (CLI Scaffolding)
   - _Requirements: Future scripts auto-build
   - Success: Running `npm run scaffold:new -- demo` creates and registers `demo` entry.

 - [ ] Port shared utilities from existing scripts
   - Role: library engineer
   - Task: Create `shared/` modules (`dom.ts`, `theme.ts`, `time.ts`, `storage.ts`, `observers.ts`, `ui/*`, `code/*`) containing extracted helpers matching existing behavior.
   - Restrictions: No behavior changes; only refactoring to shared; keep minimal comments.
   - _Leverage: original JS files
   - _Requirements: DRY, SOLID, KISS
   - Success: Utilities compile and are imported by entries.

 - [ ] Migrate Codeblock Tools to `entries/codeblock-tools` (TypeScript)
   - Role: feature porting engineer
   - Task: Re-implement the userscript using shared utilities and TS, preserving all features (collapse, wrap, search, diff/patch, +/- toggles, streaming stabilization, settings UI, line numbers, HLJS integration, language exclusion).
   - Restrictions: Preserve runtime behavior; keep external libs via `@require`.
   - _Leverage: shared modules; original `codeblock-tools.js`
   - _Requirements: Feature parity, performance
   - Success: Built `.user.js` matches behavior on ChatGPT; no regressions.

 - [ ] Migrate Mermaid Renderer to `entries/mermaid-renderer` (TypeScript)
   - Role: feature porting engineer
   - Task: Re-implement with shared utilities, preserving lazy render, caching, error capture with line/column, zoom/pan/lightbox, tabs, settings popover, fixed/elastic sizing, rerender on theme change; keep `mermaid` via `@require`.
   - Restrictions: Preserve behavior; no bundling of mermaid.
   - _Leverage: shared modules; original `mermaid-renderer.js`
   - _Requirements: Feature parity, performance
   - Success: Built `.user.js` matches behavior on ChatGPT.

 - [ ] Add zip artifacts script
   - Role: release engineer
   - Task: Implement `scripts/zip-dist.ts` and `npm run zip` to package all `.user.js` into `dist/artifacts.zip`.
   - Restrictions: No external network; pure local zip.
   - _Leverage: design.md (Scripts)
   - _Requirements: Outputs (zip optional)
   - Success: Zip file created containing all outputs.

 - [ ] Quality gates and final verification
   - Role: maintainer
   - Task: Ensure `typecheck` and `lint` clean; verify both scripts on target sites; confirm scaffolded new entry builds.
   - Restrictions: No extraneous changes or docs beyond spec.
   - _Leverage: requirements.md
   - _Requirements: Acceptance Criteria
   - Success: All gates pass; artifact ready.
